Department of Administration Division of Public Works Facilities Services Capitol Mall Parking Application for Self Pay Temporary Parking Permit 1. TERMS AND CONDITIONS A “Capitol Mall Temporary Parking Permit” is a special permit, valid for one, two, or three months, which allows the bearer to park in general Capitol Mall parking spaces. These permits cost $8 per month and are only sold in month increments. You may be eligible to purchase a Capitol Mall Temporary Parking Permit if you meet the following criteria: "Monthly temporary parking permits are available to an individual performing work or providing services to a department tenant in the Capitol Mall, but who does not receive a state of Idaho-issued paycheck." As an example, temporary parking permits are available to (a) employees of temporary service agencies (such as ProPeople); (b) employees of companies providing services to Capitol Mall employees; (c) temporary State employees such as Legislative attachés. You do not need to apply for a temporary permit if you receive your paycheck through the State Controller's Office. --IDAPA 38.04.04, https://adminrules.idaho.gov/rules/current/38/380404.pdf By using a permit issued to you, you affirm that you understand and agree to abide by the rules and regulations of IDAPA 38.04.04 as linked above. 2. APPLICATION Complete the following and submit with payment to Capitol Mall Parking Office in the basement of the State Parking Garage, 550 W. State Street. Incomplete or inaccurate information may result in a delayed or rejected application. Please make sure your vehicle license plate information is complete and correct. Name (Last, First, Middle Initial) Contact Phone Number State Agency where you are working Department Division Office Location Building Office # or Floor Vehicle license, color, make, & model License Make, Model, Color Vehicle license, color, make, & model License Make, Model, Color Signature Date: Work E-Mail Address 3. PERMIT PICKUP Print and bring this completed form with you to the office of Capitol Mall Parking office in the basement of the State Parking Garage, 550 W. State Street. It is advised to call 208-332-1932 before coming to be sure someone is in the office to help you when you arrive. Have cash (exact change) or a check ready (payable to Facilities Services). A maximum of 3 months of parking permits can be purchased at one time ($24 for 3 months). QUESTIONS? CALL 208-332-1932 or email parking@adm.idaho.gov IMPORTANT NOTES: ♦ Possession of a permit DOES NOT guarantee availability of a parking space. ♦ Payment must be received before a permit will be issued. • Payment can be made in cash (exact change) or checks made out to "Facilities Services" ♦ Upon processing and use of a permit, there will be no refunds. ♦ If permits are lost or damaged a replacement cost of equal value may apply. ♦ You must print this form and bring it with you. Rev. 05/2021
